_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a defined reference baseline of bugfest environment (currently 3 standalone tenants, and 11 consortia tenants). See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration for the backend module. Adjust replicas based on expected load and HA requirements. The scheduled cache-invalidation job (RTAC_CACHE_INVALIDATION_CRON) runs unguarded per replica; concurrent runs are idempotent deletes, so HA is safe without a distributed lock.

kong.description: Custom Kong proxy timeouts. Read timeout is raised above the 60s default because a cache-miss request synchronously fans out to inventory/circulation/orders to lazily generate the RTAC cache before responding.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed to the Java process. The default reserves 66% of container memory for the heap.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host used by the Spring datasource JDBC URL.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port used by the Spring datasource JDBC URL.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username used by the module datasource.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for DB_USERNAME.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name used by the module datasource.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL statement timeout in milliseconds applied to Hikari connections by folio-spring-base when set.

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL connection character encoding applied to Hikari connections by folio-spring-base.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Legacy FOLIO maximum database pool-size setting kept for descriptor compatibility; this Spring runtime uses DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE for Hikari maximum pool size.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host used to build spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port used to build spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_MAX_POLL_RECORDS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of Kafka records returned in a single consumer poll.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Kafka client security protocol; common values are PLAINTEXT, SSL, SASL_PLAINTEXT, and SASL_SSL.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka SSL key store when SSL client authentication is configured.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka SSL key store when SSL client authentication is configured.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka SSL trust store when SSL is configured.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka SSL trust store when SSL is configured.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical FOLIO deployment name used as the prefix for Kafka topic patterns and Kafka consumer groups.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Okapi base URL used for outbound FOLIO service calls and system-user requests. Must be provided by the deployment environment.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS
EnvVars.description: Interval in milliseconds between Kafka message delivery retry attempts.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RETRY_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of Kafka message delivery attempts before retry handling is exhausted.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumers configured for each RTAC cache Kafka listener.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_EVENTS_CONSUMER_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Optional topic-pattern override for all RTAC cache Kafka listeners. Leave empty to use the per-entity default patterns based on ENV.

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables legacy Okapi system-user token retrieval for Kafka and background downstream module calls. Leave false for Eureka deployments where sidecars provide module-to-module system tokens.

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: Username for the legacy Okapi module system user when SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the legacy Okapi module system user; required only when SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED is true in classic Okapi deployments.

EnvVars.name: RTAC_CACHE_INVALIDATION_CRON
EnvVars.description: Spring cron expression for the scheduled purge of stale rtac_holding cache rows.

EnvVars.name: RTAC_CACHE_RETENTION_DAYS
EnvVars.description: Number of days to retain cached RTAC holdings before the scheduled invalidation job deletes them.
